explanation: Repair secure from the acknowledged frame-144 open-hand state without replaying alignment, pregrasp, or ineffective descent. Revalidate historical references with current local top/support samples and independently identified visible end landmarks, then check actual finger clearance, overlap and lateral opening. Preserve the measurement guard, 3 mm guarded counter clearance, 5 mm guarded overlap and original controller tolerances. If closure margins fail or remain unresolved, permit only a separately reviewed, one-shot 12 mm upward open-hand diagnostic retreat, followed by fresh observation. Unknown closure does not veto an independently clear retreat; no unchanged descent follows it. Checkpoint the failed gate before moving and checkpoint the retreat before dispatch so a repair cannot replay it. Upward response does not establish the stall cause. Return blocked with useful measurements for contact-strategy revision, or needs_replan on changed package/support relations. Only passing current actual geometry and visual closure gates reaches the existing closure and differential-retention test.
interface: Exact replacements assemble main(api) for secure only. All outcomes preserve stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. secure.stall stores acknowledged stall history, restart state, one-shot retreat intent, actual before/after states, progress and fresh observations. Started or finished retreats cannot be replayed. secure.refinement stores current named samples, errors, local plane checks and guard provenance; secure.alignment stores current/reference end measurements, quality/model/identity thresholds and margins with frames; secure.pose_gate stores actual counter, overlap and lateral-opening operands. secure.failure names the prevented action and references persisted diagnostics. Existing geometry, progress, baseline, tracker, test and retention records remain available. Handoff lists checkpoint keys and actual state in world meters/tool-to-world xyzw. Motion makes geometry historical; retreat observations do not authorize transport, release or stage completion.
jev_protocol: Preserve exactly seven questions. x,y,z select negative/hold/positive for the explicitly named world translation component using its host goal_relation; rx,ry,rz do likewise for world rotation-vector components. Gripper open/close/keep follows objective.gripper unchanged. Jev receives program-labelled phase, local target and guard plus host proprioceptive residuals; it neither measures geometry nor judges retention. Program gates interpret fresh review fields individually for closure and retreat. All physical commands use api.drive or api.control. The one-shot retreat keeps open actuation and actual orientation, targets 12 mm upward, allows at most 12 feedback calls, uses a 4 mm translation limit and 2.5 mm pose tolerance, and reserves controls and a fresh observation. Its 8 mm rise threshold diagnoses measured robot response only. Compare full states across leases: reached is pose feedback; lease_exhausted may continue only with measured progress inside a finite allowance; stalls and mismatches stop. Do not replay earlier approach or tiny downward corrections. Existing closure settling and 55 mm lift remain separately gated. Secure completion still requires corresponding package motion compared with actual hand motion plus fresh held-clear-of-counter evidence, using quality-checked tracking or independent landmarks.
